4KLSDB: A Large-Scale Dataset for 4K Image Restoration and Generation
	

DataCV @ CVPR 2026 · Accepted 🎉


  
  
  
  
  


4KLSDB is a native-4K image dataset with 129,484 train / 2,000 val / 1,984 test images, spanning nature, urban scenes, people, food, artwork, CGI, animals, and architecture. It supports both image restoration (super-resolution) and 4K text-to-image generation.
